factions.name: The Order of the Ember Quill
factions.description: Silent monks guarding the sealed undercroft of Saint Aldwyn's Abbey.
factions.agenda: Keep the undercroft sealed, maintain the perpetual fire, watch the standing stones.

factions.name: The Greyfen Peat-Cutters
factions.description: Moorland folk who harvest peat for survival and resent the abbey's territorial claims.
factions.agenda: Secure access to the northern peat bogs, find a trade route bypassing Harrowgate.

threads.name: The Sealed Undercroft
threads.description: Something was imprisoned beneath the abbey thirty years ago. The seals are weakening.

threads.name: The Peat War
threads.description: Greyfen needs the northern bogs the abbey claims. The truce is fraying.

threads.name: The Fog's Hunger
threads.description: Disappearances in Harrowgate are increasing. The fog may not be natural.
